description: This file defines the interface for Web Audio Player IPC in the Rialto client, including factory creation, core IPC methods (play, pause, setEos, getBufferAvailable, getBufferDelay, writeBuffer, getDeviceInfo, setVolume, getVolume), and related class declarations.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating IWebAudioPlayerIpc instances.

classes.name: IWebAudioPlayerIpc
classes.description: Interface defining IPC methods for Web Audio Player communication.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayerIpc
methods.description: Creates a new IWebAudioPlayerIpc instance with specified client, mime type, priority, and config.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the number of available frames and shared memory info for audio buffer.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio frames to the buffer for playback.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device info including preferred/max frames and support for deferred play.
